"A clinical validation study showed the Cologuard Plus test is effective at ruling out CRC. [Colo-rectal cancer] Out of every 10,000 patients testing negative, approximately 2 will be falsely reassured that they do not have CRC, and out of every 100 patients testing negative, approximately 7 patients will be falsely reassured they do not have advanced pre-cancer."---Part of the narrative sent out along with the negative result of a test. Note that the 2 is really 200 per 100 patients or 0.00002 or 0.002%.
